evidence_class: agent-authored observations with raw command output preserved alongside; NOT a scorer-generated evidence bundle per AGENTS.md:167-180

thinking_is_the_serving_default.claim: The llama.cpp endpoint serves DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with reasoning enabled by default; no request flag is needed to get it, and none of the launcher flags disable it.
thinking_is_the_serving_default.launcher_check: grep for thinking|reasoning|chat-template|chat_template|jinja in scripts/21_serve_llamacpp.sh returns no matches, so the serving default comes from the model's own template rather than from any flag this repo sets.
thinking_is_the_serving_default.decision: Owner directive 2026-08-09: thinking is always set moving forward. scripts/31_bench_accuracy.py --thinking-mode now defaults to 'thinking'.
thinking_is_the_serving_default.why: 0731 scores 201/253 on MMLU-Pro dev under the thinking rendering against 178/253 under the chat rendering (results/dsv4-0731-staging/acc-mmlu-pro-dev-0731-thinking-2048.json and acc-mmlu-pro-dev-0731.json, ds4 arm). Defaulting to chat measured a contract the endpoint does not serve and discarded roughly nine points of the model's capability.

defect_found_and_fixed.introduced_by: this workstream, commit 2d0e367, when --thinking-mode was added
defect_found_and_fixed.finding: The --thinking-mode help text asserted that the rendering mode 'is recorded in the config digest ... so runs under different contracts cannot be silently compared'. derive_config_digest() did not include it. max_tokens was present; thinking_mode was not.
defect_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: config_digest keys the holdout ledger (spend_holdout_budget) and is what scripts/36_audit_accuracy.py matches ledger entries against. A chat run and a thinking run over the same stack/suite/split produced an identical digest, so the two contracts were indistinguishable to every digest-keyed consumer -- precisely the silent cross-contract comparison the flag was added to prevent.
defect_found_and_fixed.detected_by: reading derive_config_digest while implementing the default flip; the help text made a claim the code did not honour
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: thinking_mode added to the digest payload, with a RED test first (scripts/tests/test_bench_accuracy_thinking_contract.py)
defect_found_and_fixed.frozen_evidence_impact: none. No consumer recomputes the digest; 36_audit_accuracy.py reads the recorded value. Digests frozen before this change remain valid and still match their ledger rows. A future re-run under --thinking-mode chat will not reproduce a pre-2026-08-09 digest, which is correct: the old payload could not express the rendering it ran under. REPRODUCING.md now states this.

stale_weight_accounting.question: Where did the ~90 GiB of pre-0731 weights go? Deleting the *.gguf.pre0731 links freed no measurable space.
stale_weight_accounting.answer: Two full independent pre-0731 copies exist under /var/lib/dsv4-context/models/, 96832507552 bytes (90.18 GiB) each, 180.37 GiB total. Both are root-owned mode 0444 with link count 1, so they are independent inodes and not hardlink partners of anything in the repo.
stale_weight_accounting.identified_by: shard 1 is 5256864 bytes in both directories. The 0731 release's shard 1 is 5257664 bytes. Shards 2 and 3 are byte-identical in size across the two releases, so size alone cannot distinguish them -- shard 1 is the only discriminator, and it says pre-0731.

copies.origin: scripts/64_context_submit.sh:85 renames the previous protected copy aside as deepseek-v4-flash-replaced-$CANDIDATE_HASH and never deletes it

stale_weight_accounting.still_unaccounted: The pre-0731 shards deleted from weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/ had link count 2. Neither /var/lib copy is that second link (both are link count 1, distinct inodes). The owner's `find / -xdev -type f -size 49437013568c` returned only the two /var/lib paths and did not list the currently-served 0731 shards, which are that exact size and on the same filesystem -- so that output was partial and the search must be repeated before concluding a third copy does or does not exist.

correctness_finding.finding: scripts/64_context_submit.sh validates the protected model copy by existence, non-symlink, uid 0, and link count 1 (lines 60-63). It does not compare the copy's digest against the live weights manifest. The copy is therefore currently pre-0731 while the endpoint serves 0731.
correctness_finding.why_it_matters: Any root-mode run of the 512K/1M context qualification (scripts 57/58/62) would measure the pre-0731 release and label the result with the current candidate hash. That is a silent cross-release substitution inside the repository's own capability evidence, and it is live right now.
correctness_finding.relation_to_review: This is the same class as the xhigh reviewer's finding 10 (the DeepSeek comparison profile does not bind the served GGUF generation), reached independently and on a different code path.
correctness_finding.required_before_context_qualification: Refresh the protected copy from the 0731 weights, and add a digest comparison against weights/unsloth-ud-q2_k_xl/manifest.json to the validity check so a generation mismatch fails closed instead of running.
